candidate.name: intraday_return_amount_cumulative_path_signed_area_238p
candidate.economic_hypothesis: Within-session transaction-amount arrival that precedes favorable signed price discovery produces a positive oriented path area and may indicate information-supported continuation from the next open through the third close.
candidate.exact_formula: For each 120-bar half separately, form 119 adjacent log-close returns r_i and use destination-bar nonnegative amount a_i. Let dx_i=r_i/sum_j(abs(r_j)), dy_i=a_i/sum_j(a_j), X_0=Y_0=0, X_i=sum_{j<=i}(dx_j), and Y_i=sum_{j<=i}(dy_j). The half score is 0.5*sum_i(Y_{i-1}*dx_i-X_{i-1}*dy_i). The stock-day score is the arithmetic mean of the morning and afternoon half scores.

nearest_complete_definition_review.name: intraday_amount_lead_return_correlation_238p
nearest_complete_definition_review.overlap: Both use signed close returns and transaction amount with temporal order.
nearest_complete_definition_review.distinction: The terminal factor is a one-step Pearson correlation between earlier log amount and the next return. Campaign145 is a within-half cumulative path line integral, uses destination amount mass, has no covariance normalization and captures global ordering rather than one-lag linear dependence.

nearest_complete_definition_review.name: intraday_amount_price_discovery_alignment_js_238p
nearest_complete_definition_review.overlap: Both normalize amount and close-return-derived mass.
nearest_complete_definition_review.distinction: The terminal factor is simultaneous, unsigned and order-insensitive after endpoint alignment. Campaign145 preserves return sign and path order and measures orientation; identical unsigned distributions can have opposite Campaign145 scores.

nearest_complete_definition_review.name: intraday_directional_amount_timing_spread_238m
nearest_complete_definition_review.overlap: Both distinguish positive and negative return timing with amount.
nearest_complete_definition_review.distinction: The terminal factor subtracts amount-weighted clock centroids conditional on return sign. Campaign145 has no positive/negative subset centroid or fixed clock coordinate; it integrates the two cumulative paths and weights signed return magnitude.

nearest_complete_definition_review.name: intraday_amount_volatility_coupling_238p
nearest_complete_definition_review.overlap: Both join price change and amount.
nearest_complete_definition_review.distinction: The terminal factor is pointwise Pearson dependence of absolute return and log amount. Campaign145 uses signed normalized increments and cumulative order with no pointwise correlation.

nearest_complete_definition_review.name: intraday_amount_center_of_mass_240m
nearest_complete_definition_review.distinction: The terminal factor is an amount-only fixed-clock center. Campaign145 is translation-free in observation index within each half and requires a signed return path.

nearest_complete_definition_review.name: intraday_cumulative_vwap_crossing_rate_240m_candidate49
nearest_complete_definition_review.overlap: Both contain a causal cumulative state.
nearest_complete_definition_review.distinction: Candidate49 counts close crossings around cumulative transaction VWAP and remains prospective-only. Campaign145 forms no VWAP, reference crossing, volume ratio or Candidate49 value and cannot enter Candidate49's signal or execution ledgers.
